name: Satchel
author: MarshalX
description: One list of everything you own, across every character. Bags, bank and mailbox are recorded as they are read, so an item is one row with a total however many stacks and characters hold it, and hovering says who has how many and where. What a vendor would pay for a bag, a bank and the whole account.

preview.alt: On the left, Everything you own, one row an item, pooled across every character On the right, One character, live, the bags of the character in play, as a grid of squares, one of them padlocked

companionReasons.lorebind: publishes what every item is called and what a vendor pays, which is what puts a name and a worth on these rows

keybinds.label: Show or hide the bag panel

settings.label: Warn when this many slots are left
Play a cue when the warning trips
Remember every character's bags, bank and mail across sessions
